commands:
sh -c '. /etc/os-release && KEY=/tmp/pgdg.asc && LIST=/tmp/pgdg.list && curl -fsSL https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc -o "$KEY" && printf "deb http://deb.debian.org/debian %s main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian %s-updates main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian-security %s-security main
" "$VERSION_CODENAME" "$VERSION_CODENAME" "$VERSION_CODENAME" > "$LIST" && echo "deb [signed-by=$KEY] https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt ${VERSION_CODENAME}-pgdg main" >> "$LIST" && cat "$LIST" && apt-get -o Dir::Etc::SourceList="$LIST" -o Dir::Etc::SourceParts=/dev/null update && apt-get -o Dir::Etc::SourceList="$LIST" -o Dir::Etc::SourceParts=/dev/null install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-client-18 && cp -a /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpq.so.5* /usr/lib/postgresql/18/lib/ && /usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin/pg_dump --version && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*'
